summary: Explains using TM or SM before a mark is registered and the ® symbol after registration, so Ansible keeps its rights to the marks.
questions: Why do Ansible docs use TM and ® symbols?
When do you switch from TM to ®?

answer_card.title: Why trademark symbols matter
answer_card.answer_md: Before registration with the USPTO, use **TM** (goods) or **SM** (services) to signal Ansible claims the mark. After registration, use **®**. Consistent use protects the mark from becoming generic (like Aspirin or Escalator).
